acceptanceCriteria: Malformed arguments on each of the four directives fail closed with a typed refusal, each covered by a test.
body: Residual from PR #1532 (V1-2317, AFP-V0-050(3)). The strict go.work grammar checks directive names but not the arguments of go, toolchain, godebug and replace lines, so malformed values pass.
title: gateselect go.work parser does not validate arguments on go/toolchain/godebug/replace lines
